CreateNodeGroupV2.clusterRole: Node role in the cluster. Only Node type is supported currently, default is node
CreateNodeGroupV2.shrinkPolicy: Node group scale-down policy. Options: [Priority, Uniform]. Default: Priority. Priority shrinks nodes with lower priority first; Uniform scales down evenly across subnets
CreateNodeGroupV2.updatePolicy: Node group update policy. Options: [Rolling, Concurrency]. Default: Concurrency. Concurrency updates nodes simultaneously; Rolling updates nodes sequentially. This parameter is not yet active
CreateNodeGroupV2.cleanPolicy: Node cleanup policy. Options: [Remain, Delete]. Default: Delete
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate: Node configuration template for the node group
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.checkGPUDriver: Whether to verify GPU driver installation
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.scaleDownDisabled: Whether scale-down is disabled for this node
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.isOpenHostnameDomain: Whether to enable hostname domain resolution
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.needEIP: Whether to assign an Elastic IP
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.iamRole: IAM role bound to the instance
CreateNodeGroupV2.instanceTemplate.deploySetIDs: Deployment set IDs for instance placement
CreateNodeGroupV2.replicas: Desired replica count for the node group. Valid values: non-negative integers
CreateNodeGroupV2.clusterAutoscalerSpec.scalingGroupPriori: Priority of this node group in autoscaling decisions
